title.en: An Act Amending Chapter One of Act Numbered Twenty Four Hundred and Twenty-Seven, Known as "the Insurance Act," So as to Provide a Time Limit of Not Less than One Year for Bringing Suit Under Any Policy of Insurance, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
Chapter one of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and twenty-seven is hereby amended by
inserting the following section therein:
"Section 61-A. Any condition, stipulation or agreement in any policy of insurance, limiting the time for
commencing an action thereunder to a period of less than one year from the time when the cause of action
accrues, is void."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1933.
